pairs: He who was from the beginning,
whom we have seen with our eyes,
et manus nostræ contrectaverunt de verbo vitæ:
and whom our hands have certainly touched: He is the Word of Life.
And that Life has been made manifest.
and we announce to you: the Eternal Life,
He whom we have seen and heard,
ut et vos societatem habeatis nobiscum,
so that you, too, may have fellowship with us,
et societas nostra sit cum Patre, et cum Filio ejus Jesu Christo.
and so that our fellowship may be with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
Et hæc scribimus vobis ut gaudeatis,
And this we write to you, so that you may rejoice,
and so that your joy may be full.
Et hæc est annuntiatio, quam audivimus ab eo,
And this is the announcement which we have heard from him,
et annuntiamus vobis: quoniam Deus lux est,
and which we announce to you: that God is light,
et tenebræ in eo non sunt ullæ.
and in him there is no darkness.
Si dixerimus quoniam societatem habemus cum eo,
If we claim that we have fellowship with him,
and yet we walk in darkness,
Si autem in luce ambulamus sicut
But if we walk in the light,
just as he also is in the light,
then we have fellowship with one another,
and the blood of Jesus Christ,
Si dixerimus quoniam peccatum non habemus,
If we claim that we have no sin,
et veritas in nobis non est.
and the truth is not in us.
so as to forgive us our sins
et emundet nos ab omni iniquitate.
and to cleanse us from all iniquity.
If we claim that we have not sinned,
then we make him a liar,
et verbum ejus non est in nobis.
and his Word is not in us.
